entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The samosa Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/samosa* (and the old /retro-games/samosa*), with its static game and the D1 database samosa-scores.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/samosa/ and its public scores page.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/dictator (npm run build, then wrangler deploy; it does not run the tests first), with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account (or wrangler logged in to it). Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners: the Deploy workflow was removed (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21).
approvals: The owner's decision: nothing deploys on its own, and only the owner runs the deploy.
A pull request, tested by CI, for anything that reaches main: main accepts nothing else.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and run npm run deploy again, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare. A database migration is not undone by this; migrations are written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's routes run ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. workers_dev and preview_urls are off, so there is no other address. The database was created once by hand from worker/schema.sql; since then it changes only through worker/migrations/.
